messages.content: Modify src/lib.rs to add a new function.

content.text: I'll start by looking at the project and `src/lib.rs` to understand what's there.
Those two tools aren't available here — I'll use the allowed ones instead.
This crate is small — `src/lib.rs` currently has just `add` plus one test. I don't want to guess at a function signature you'd have to throw away, so one quick question:

questions.question: What should the new function in src/lib.rs be?

options.label: subtract(a, b)
options.description: Add `pub fn subtract(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 { a - b }` with a `test_subtract` case, mirroring the existing `add` style. Quick and idiomatic for this crate.

options.label: multiply(a, b)
options.description: Add `pub fn multiply(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 { a * b }` with a test, same style as `add`.

options.label: I'll specify it
options.description: Tell me the name, signature, behavior, and I'll implement exactly that (including tests if you want them).

content.text: The question tool is blocked too, so I'll go with the most sensible default: a `subtract` companion to `add`, matching the file's existing style (plain `pub fn`, `i32`, paired test).
`Write` is blocked in this session (as the earlier marker noted), so I'll use `Edit` instead.

agent.description: Name of a custom agent defined in ~/.coderex/agents/*.json. Takes precedence over subagent_type. An unknown name is an error that lists the configured names.

writable.description: Whether the sub-agent may write files. false restricts it to read-only tools (Read, Grep, Glob). Defaults to true.

max_retries.description: Shorthand for retry_policy.max_retries when retry_policy is not supplied.
